_style: Hyperrealistic cinematic space art, vertical composition, deep black space with faint stars, surreal and dramatic lighting, ultra detailed, photographic. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no border, no frame.
FIRST-LIGHT: The first beam of starlight entering the open dome of a lone observatory telescope on a dark mountain, a thin shaft of white light falling into the mirror, the Milky Way blazing above.
IMILAC: A pallasite meteorite (Imilac): a chunk of shining nickel-iron filled with glowing translucent golden-green olivine crystals, floating in deep black space at center, lit from behind by a blazing orange sun in the upper right corner, rim light and lens glow, tiny dust particles.
LUNAR-FRAGMENT: A grey lunar meteorite rock, pitted and cratered breccia, floating large in the foreground of black space, the crescent Moon looming behind it in the upper right, hard white sunlight from the side.
EARTH: Planet Earth from space at the edge of night, blue oceans, white clouds and green continents on the day side, golden city lights glowing across the night side, a thin blue atmosphere halo, a tiny Moon in the distance.
EARTHRISE: Earthrise: the blue and white Earth, half lit, rising above the grey cratered horizon of the Moon, seen from lunar orbit, black sky.
CHICXULUB: A city-sized asteroid on fire, glowing orange with entry heat, about to strike a prehistoric Earth ocean coastline seen from low orbit, a long burning trail, clouds below.
TUNGUSKA: A blinding airburst explosion high above an endless Siberian pine forest at dawn, a white-orange fireball and shock wave flattening trees in a radial pattern below, smoke rising.
SPUTNIK-1: Sputnik 1, the polished silver sphere satellite with four long swept-back antennas, orbiting above the curved night side of Earth, sunlight glinting on its metal surface.
ISS: The International Space Station with its long golden solar arrays, orbiting above the blue curve of Earth, the sun flaring over the horizon behind it.
HUBBLE: The Hubble Space Telescope, silver cylinder with open aperture door and two solar panel wings, drifting above the blue Earth with a colourful nebula in the background.
JWST: The James Webb Space Telescope with its giant honeycomb of eighteen golden hexagonal mirrors and its huge purple-silver sunshield, floating in deep space, a distant galaxy field behind it.
MOON: The full Moon, huge and detailed, grey craters and dark maria sharply visible, floating over a cratered grey lunar landscape of boulders in the foreground.
APOLLO-11: The Apollo 11 lunar module Eagle standing on the grey lunar surface beside an American flag and bootprints in the dust, the blue Earth hanging in the black sky above.
TYCHO: Tycho crater on the Moon seen from low orbit, a sharp crater with a central peak and bright rays of ejecta, long shadows, the curved lunar horizon and black sky above.
SUN: The Sun, enormous and blazing, filling the right side of the frame, its surface a churning orange plasma, giant solar prominences and flares arcing off its edge into black space.
MERCURY: The planet Mercury, a grey heavily cratered world lit hard from one side, half in shadow, floating in black space with the glare of the nearby sun at the edge of the frame.
VENUS: The planet Venus, a golden-orange world wrapped in thick swirling sulfuric cloud bands, glowing with fiery light from the nearby sun, wisps of hot atmosphere.
MARS: The planet Mars, rust red and detailed, rising over a rocky red Martian desert landscape with boulders in the foreground, thin dusty atmosphere.
OLYMPUS-MONS: Olympus Mons, the giant shield volcano of Mars, its vast caldera rim seen from high above the thin red atmosphere, cliffs plunging to the plains, the curve of Mars on the horizon.
VALLES-MARINERIS: Valles Marineris, an immense canyon system on Mars, layered red cliffs plunging seven kilometres deep, dust haze in the valley, seen at a low dramatic angle at sunset.
JUPITER: Planet Jupiter, huge, its striped cream and rust cloud bands and the Great Red Spot sharply detailed, filling the right side of the frame, lit from the side, with two small rocky moons floating in front and a scattered field of asteroids below.
IO: Io, the yellow and orange sulfur moon of Jupiter, with a towering blue-white volcanic plume erupting from its surface, giant striped Jupiter looming behind it.
EUROPA: Europa, the icy moon of Jupiter, white and cream ice crust criss-crossed with long reddish-brown cracks, huge Jupiter in the background, cold blue light.
GANYMEDE: Ganymede, the largest moon in the solar system, grey and brown grooved icy terrain, faint blue aurora glowing at its poles, Jupiter rising behind it.
SL9: A string of comet fragments, a glowing chain of twenty-one icy nuclei with tails, streaking toward giant Jupiter, dark impact scars already blooming on its southern clouds.
SATURN: Planet Saturn and its rings seen at a steep angle, golden cream globe, the vast rings sweeping across the frame, ring particles and icy boulders scattered in the foreground.
TITAN: Titan, the moon of Saturn, a hazy orange globe wrapped in thick golden smog, Saturn and its rings faint behind it, and in the foreground dark methane lakes on Titan's orange surface.
ENCELADUS: Enceladus, the small white icy moon of Saturn, with tall glittering geysers of ice spraying from blue tiger-stripe cracks at its south pole, Saturn's rings behind it.
URANUS: Planet Uranus, a smooth pale cyan-blue ice giant tipped on its side, its thin dark rings standing vertically around it, cold faint sunlight, small moons nearby.
NEPTUNE: Planet Neptune, a deep blue ice giant with white methane clouds and a dark storm, faint thin rings, icy moons and frozen boulders floating in the foreground, cold blue light.
PLUTO: Pluto, the dwarf planet, its bright cream heart-shaped nitrogen ice plain and reddish brown highlands, a thin blue haze around its edge, its moon Charon in the distance.
HALLEY: Halley's Comet, a dark icy nucleus jetting bright gas, its long glowing blue-white tail streaming across a starry sky.
OUMUAMUA: Oumuamua, a long dark reddish cigar-shaped interstellar rock tumbling through space past the distant Sun, sunlight glinting on one side.
VOYAGER-1: The Voyager 1 spacecraft with its large white dish antenna and long booms, alone in the dark at the edge of the solar system, the Sun a distant bright star behind it.
BIG-DIPPER: The seven bright stars of the Big Dipper glowing in a deep night sky above a dark mountain ridge silhouette, the Milky Way faint behind them.
ORION: The constellation Orion rising over a dark desert horizon, red Betelgeuse and blue Rigel bright, the three belt stars in a row, the pink Orion Nebula glowing in the sword.
SOUTHERN-CROSS: The Southern Cross constellation, four bright blue-white stars, next to the dark Coalsack nebula, set in the dense southern Milky Way above a silhouette of a lone tree.
SUMMER-TRIANGLE: Three brilliant stars Vega, Deneb and Altair forming a large triangle in the summer night sky, the bright Milky Way running through it, above a dark meadow.
ALPHA-CEN: Alpha Centauri, two bright golden suns close together in space with a small red dwarf star far off, seen from the rocky surface of an alien planet.
SIRIUS: Sirius, an intensely bright blue-white star with dazzling diffraction spikes and glow, a tiny white dwarf companion beside it, deep starfield.
VEGA: Vega, a brilliant blue-white star surrounded by a faint glowing dust disk, rapidly spinning, deep starfield.
ARCTURUS: Arcturus, a large orange giant star glowing warm amber, with soft corona, deep starfield.
ALDEBARAN: Aldebaran, a huge orange-red giant star glowing in front of the scattered Hyades star cluster.
POLARIS: Polaris, the North Star, bright and steady at the centre of circular star trails over a snowy mountain.
MIRA: Mira, a dying pulsating red giant star shedding a long glowing comet-like tail of gas as it races through space.
BETELGEUSE: Betelgeuse, a colossal red supergiant star, its boiling surface of huge convection cells, puffs of dust and gas around it, the planet Mars tiny in comparison beside it.
ANTARES: Antares, an enormous blazing red supergiant star surrounded by colourful yellow and red dust clouds of the Rho Ophiuchi region.
RIGEL: Rigel, a blinding blue-white supergiant star with intense glow and diffraction spikes, lighting a wispy blue reflection nebula nearby.
ETA-CARINAE: Eta Carinae, a massive star hidden inside a glowing twin-lobed hourglass nebula of orange and pink gas, violent and bright.
TRAPPIST-1: The TRAPPIST-1 system: a small dim red dwarf star with seven rocky Earth-sized planets lined up in front of it, red light on their surfaces.
M45: The Pleiades star cluster, seven brilliant blue stars wrapped in wispy blue reflection nebula, deep space.
M44: The Beehive star cluster, a swarm of hundreds of golden and white stars in deep space.
HELIX: The Helix Nebula, a giant glowing eye in space, a blue-green core ringed with red and orange gas.
M57: The Ring Nebula, a glowing ring of blue, green and red gas around a tiny white dwarf star.
CATS-EYE: The Cat's Eye Nebula, intricate glowing shells of green and red gas, concentric rings around a bright central star.
M42: The Orion Nebula, a vast glowing cloud of pink, red and blue gas lit by four bright young stars at its heart.
HORSEHEAD: The Horsehead Nebula, a dark horse-head shaped dust cloud silhouetted against glowing red hydrogen gas.
ROSETTE: The Rosette Nebula, a huge red flower-shaped cloud of glowing gas with a hollow centre full of bright young stars.
VEIL: The Veil Nebula, delicate glowing filaments of blue, green and red gas, threads of an ancient supernova shock wave.
M8: The Lagoon Nebula, a glowing pink and red cloud of gas with dark dust lanes and bright young stars.
M20: The Trifid Nebula, a red glowing cloud split by three dark dust lanes, next to a blue reflection nebula.
M16: The Pillars of Creation, towering columns of dark brown dust and gas glowing gold and teal at their edges, newborn stars inside.
M1: The Crab Nebula, a tangled glowing cloud of orange filaments around a blue glowing core with a pulsar at its centre.
CARINA: The Carina Nebula, towering cliffs of glowing gas and dust in gold and blue, a stellar nursery lit by massive stars.
OMEGA-CEN: Omega Centauri, a dense glowing ball of ten million golden and white stars, a globular cluster in deep space.
M13: The Hercules globular cluster, a dense sphere of hundreds of thousands of white and golden stars.
TARANTULA: The Tarantula Nebula, a huge glowing web of pink and blue gas with a cluster of blazing blue giant stars.
MILKY-WAY: The Milky Way galaxy seen from above, a vast spiral of golden core and blue arms with pink star-forming regions.
LMC: The Large Magellanic Cloud, an irregular dwarf galaxy full of pink nebulae and blue star clusters, seen over a dark southern horizon.
SMC: The Small Magellanic Cloud, a glowing irregular dwarf galaxy cloud of stars and pink nebulae in deep space.
M31: The Andromeda galaxy, a huge spiral galaxy seen at a tilt, glowing golden core and blue spiral arms with dark dust lanes.
M33: The Triangulum galaxy, a loose face-on spiral galaxy with blue arms dotted with pink nebulae.
M82: The Cigar galaxy, an edge-on galaxy with huge red plumes of gas blasting out of its centre.
CEN-A: Centaurus A, a giant galaxy crossed by a thick dark dust lane with bright blue jets shooting out from its core.
M101: The Pinwheel galaxy, a large face-on spiral galaxy with sweeping blue arms and a bright core.
M51: The Whirlpool galaxy, a grand spiral galaxy pulling on a smaller yellow companion galaxy.
M104: The Sombrero galaxy, edge-on, a brilliant white bulge crossed by a dark dust rim.
M87: The giant elliptical galaxy M87, a glowing golden sphere with a long blue jet shooting from its core.
CARTWHEEL: The Cartwheel galaxy, a bright blue ring galaxy around a golden core with spokes, a small galaxy nearby.
SGR-A: Sagittarius A*, the black hole at the heart of the Milky Way, a dark shadow inside a glowing orange ring of light, dense stars around.
SN-1987A: Supernova 1987A, a glowing ring of bright beads around an exploded star, red glowing gas.
TON-618: TON 618, an ultramassive black hole with a blazing bright white accretion disk and twin jets, surrounded by darkness.
HUBBLE-DEEP-FIELD: The Hubble Deep Field, thousands of tiny colourful galaxies of every shape scattered across deep black space.
CMB: The cosmic microwave background, a mottled glowing map of blue and orange hot and cold spots wrapped around a sphere in space.
TOTAL-ECLIPSE: A total solar eclipse, the black disk of the Moon surrounded by the glowing white solar corona and pink prominences, over a dark mountain.
RING-OF-FIRE: An annular solar eclipse, a perfect ring of fire around the dark Moon, glowing orange sky.
BLOOD-MOON: A total lunar eclipse, the Moon glowing deep red and copper, huge, over a dark landscape of trees.
AURORA: The aurora borealis, vivid green and purple curtains of light swirling over snowy mountains and a frozen lake reflection.
VENUS-TRANSIT: The transit of Venus, a small perfectly black dot crossing the huge glowing orange face of the Sun.
HALE-BOPP: Comet Hale-Bopp, bright with two long tails, one blue and one white, over a dark desert landscape at twilight.
LEONIDS: The Leonid meteor storm, hundreds of bright meteor streaks raining from one point in the night sky over a dark mountain.
PERSEIDS: The Perseid meteor shower, bright meteor streaks crossing the summer Milky Way over a silhouetted forest.
CANYON-DIABLO: A rusty iron meteorite (Canyon Diablo), dark metal with deep thumbprint dents, floating in deep space, giant Jupiter at the upper right behind it, small asteroids and dust around.
GIBEON: A slice of the Gibeon iron meteorite, polished silver metal etched with a crisscross Widmanstatten crystal pattern, floating in space, lit by a blue-white star.
CAMPO-DEL-CIELO: A massive iron meteorite (Campo del Cielo) of dark rusted metal, glowing red-hot along its edges as it falls through a fiery sky.
MUONIONALUSTA: The Muonionalusta iron meteorite, an ancient polished slab of silver metal with a crystal etch pattern, floating above frozen arctic snow under the northern lights.
ALLENDE: The Allende meteorite, a dark grey carbonaceous stone with bright white mineral inclusions, floating in space beside a young glowing sun.
ORIONIDS: The Orionid meteor shower, fast bright meteors streaking from Orion's constellation over a dark landscape.
HUNTERS-MOON: A huge orange full moon rising over a dark autumn forest and hills at dusk.
PLEIADES-OCCULTATION: The Moon passing in front of the blue Pleiades star cluster, the moon's bright edge hiding the stars one by one.
GEMINIDS: The Geminid meteor shower, many bright colourful meteors streaking across a cold winter night sky over snowy pines.
CHRISTMAS-SUPERMOON: A huge bright supermoon rising over a snowy winter village at night.
DOUBLE-OPPOSITION: Mars and Jupiter both shining brightly in the night sky above a dark horizon, Mars red and Jupiter white.
SNOW-MOON-ECLIPSE: A partial lunar eclipse, the full Moon with a dusky red shadow on one edge, over a snowy winter landscape.
GREAT-ECLIPSE: A total solar eclipse with a long dramatic diamond ring effect, glowing corona, over a wide dark landscape with crowds silhouetted on a hill.
